title: PDF Generator
description: A PDF workbench: pick a document type, live-edit its JSON data, CSS, and HTML beside a paper preview, and download a real PDF — schema-driven from the documents kernel, so a new document type is a new template directory, not new code.

theme.$comment: A print shop at night, in black and white (the recent achromatic restyle, preserved verbatim as the seed): pure-black bench, monospace signage, lamp-white accent, and the document as the only color on screen. The palette's dark values are the page's pre-AppShell art constants so the shell chrome and the bench read as one surface; the light values are the same press with the lights on. The shell defaults to top-nav because the press is one workbench whose only navigation is the document-type picker — its old chrome was a lone topbar; content is flush because the workbench owns its own scroll regions (editor and pasteboard).
